questions.question: Paul wrote that God chose His people before the world was made. What did God choose them to be?

answers.text: Holy and blameless in His presence
Rulers over every nation on earth
Teachers of the law in every city

questions.question: Paul wrote that through Jesus Christ, God planned ahead for His people to receive what?
Paul wrote about God's plan for the fullness of time. What will that plan do?

answers.text: Bring all things in heaven and on earth together in Christ
Keep the things of heaven apart from the things of earth
Set every nation on earth under the law of Moses

questions.question: Paul told the Ephesians they were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit before they had heard the gospel. True or false?
